C1.name: cold_first_statement
C1.timer: client perf_counter_ns around execute/fetch/native result metadata

C2.name: first_noncompile_path
C2.timer: same-operation interval union after compiler return

W.name: steady_state
W.timer: execute/fetch/native result metadata after cold sample and cache warmup

status_semantics.evidence: typed compile/admission receipt, schema identity and complete-result validation
status_semantics.model: G-Stats/G-Cost admitted only after declared calibration
status_semantics.regression: paired normal trace-off C1 comparison against declared baseline

derivation.normal: Accepted normal attempt, Verified receipt with compilation=Executed and cache_hit=false; compiler_elapsed_us / 1000. Cached warm receipts are not new compilations.
derivation.diagnostic: Separate accepted Detail capture; optimizer_work bucket exclusive_ns / 1e6. Not subtracted from normal client timings.
derivation.percentile: Maintained tpcds_compare.percentile, fraction=0.9; descriptive only at six fresh samples per arm.
derivation.identities: All source/build/input/harness identities matched within arm and across shared input fields; exact artifact and selection/resource identities equal across all normal receipts and shared artifact identity equal to corresponding diagnostic capture.
derivation.warm: Q04 batch 1 crossed the pre-registered 10% investigation threshold. All samples retained; combined six-block changes are below that threshold but do not certify non-inferiority.
